description: Get a company's shareholder meeting vote results from its SEC 8-K Item 5.07 filings, latest meeting first: for each matter (each director nominee on its own row) the For, Against, Abstain, Withheld and broker non-vote counts as printed, the stated outcome and its quote, and the source filing. An 8-K/A replaces the 8-K only if it restates every matter; else both are shown. Only verified readings are shown; an empty answer says whether no vote filing is on file or one still awaits extraction.

meetings.description: Number of meetings to return, newest first (default 1, max 10).

name: GetShareholderVoteResults
title: Shareholder Vote Results
